in_domain_scaling.claim: Increasing in-domain SOE training animals continuously strengthens held-animal prospective social efficacy.

content_specificity.claim: The scaling gain depends on correct social content rather than generic added trajectory information.

future_prediction.claim: SWM future-motif NLL beats the strongest direct nonlinear MLP in 25/27 animals and retains an advantage over Markov across 1-, 3-, and 5-step horizons.

interpretation: Task-specific world-state scaling is strongly positive even though the initial generic 12-cell neural forecast scaling sweep plateaus after ~50 sessions. This separates a substrate/optimization bottleneck from an absence of learnable world-state scaling.
